messages:
Maya (PM): quick design review — prototyped a "network prereq scanner" card for the Private setup wizard. It auto-runs checks (CIDR reachability, DNS resolution, TLS handshake on 443) and surfaces guided fixes. mock attached in figma link. Cheng (Design): love the idea. two UX asks: 1) make failure copy actionable (eg 'Open port 443 to on your firewall') not just 'blocked' 2) don't rely on color alone — add icon + assistive text for a11y. Liam (Eng): implementation note — we currently only have server-side probes that can reach our control plane. browser-based probes can't touch private subnets. do we want an 'agent required' fallback? Alex (DevEx): copy tweak proposal: change CTA from 'Run network checks' -> 'Verify network prerequisites'. also add a one-line explainer under the title: 'This checks connectivity required for Private deployments.' Cheng (Design): contrast nit: the orange warning label on the light panel fails AA at 14px. either increase weight, use darker color, or add an icon badge. also add aria-live for status updates so screenreaders get progress. Maya (PM): proposed failure copy: "Couldn’t reach the private endpoint. Tip: ensure your VPC route tables and firewall allow outbound HTTPS (443) to . [Run help diagnostics]" — reactions? Liam (Eng): prefer placeholders instead of concrete IPs in UI copy. use '' and expose the actual ranges in a tooltip / KB article. otherwise people will copy-paste the wrong thing. Alex (DevEx): keyboard + screenreader flow: scanner panel must be focusable, progress announced as 'Scanning: step X of Y', and final state moves focus to the primary CTA. suggested aria snippet below for devs: ```
Scanning network... 2/5 checks passed
``` Onboarding-bot: diagnostic report uploaded: scan_log_1924681357.txt — shows DNS timeouts from probe to customer subnet, port 443 closed on first hop. Cheng (Design): UX small: collapse advanced diagnostics behind a 'Show details' disclosure and link to the KB. change CTA text from 'Retry' to 'Re-run checks' so intent is clearer. also add an inline 'Why this matters' link under the panel heading. Maya (PM): action items: @Cheng update mockups with icon+contrast and the collapsed details; @Alex draft the final copy and aria guidance (PR); @Liam confirm feasibility of server-scan vs agent fallback and list security review points by EOD. I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to close. :calendar: Liam (Eng): ack — i'll validate server scan limitations and propose agent flow if needed. Cheng (Design): adding one more: for failures include one-line remediation steps and a copyable CLI snippet (eg `curl -v https://`). keeps support threads shorter. Maya (PM): yes — include copyable snippets in details. thanks team, will follow up with meeting invite. :thumbsup:
